Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog:
Themes and Widget Customization (Testing)
- Added themed meter layouts across the existing palettes, plus Sakura and Confection styles.
- Added optional animated header backgrounds and effect-strength controls.
- Improved theme performance with cached custom palettes, lighter picker previews, and skipped off-screen effects.
- Fixed DPS Meter name redaction for all captured players.
- Added independent DPS Meter background-opacity and icon-size controls.
- Disabled the native background-blur option on Better Deaths windows.
